about_the_game:
Enter into the fevered daydreams of a young boy, left alone at home while his mother works, he wanders from the safety of his house and stumbles into a shadowy underworld teeming with gallant knights, menacing skeletons, and cryptic mysteries. Navigate a cunningly crafted, interconnected labyrinth pulsing with secrets and danger. In this gripping side-scroller puzzle adventure, scour the gloom for keys to unlock hidden doors, crack intricate color combination puzzles, and outsmart sinister skeletons to carve your path. Compact yet profound, this haunting journey blends clever mechanics with a dreamlike atmosphere, challenging you to unravel its enigmas in a short but unforgettable tale.

Key Features:

  • Intricate, interconnected underworld brimming with secrets to uncover

  • Collect keys to unlock doors and access new, perilous areas

  • Solve clever color combination puzzles to progress

  • Evade and outwit evil skeletons lurking in the shadows
